SSC CHSL Apply Online 2026: Your Gateway to Government Jobs

Aspiring candidates eyeing a prestigious career in various government departments, get ready! The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) is all set to release the Combined Higher Secondary Level (CHSL) Examination 2026 notification. This eagerly awaited recruitment drive offers a golden opportunity for 12th-pass individuals to secure positions as Lower Division Clerks (LDC), Junior Secretariat Assistants (JSA), Data Entry Operators (DEO), and Postal Assistants/Sorting Assistants across numerous Central Government ministries and offices.

The online application process for SSC CHSL 2026 is expected to commence soon after the official notification, making it crucial for candidates to be well-prepared with all the necessary information and documents. This comprehensive guide will walk you through the essential details, from important dates and eligibility criteria to a step-by-step application process, ensuring a smooth and successful submission.

SSC CHSL 2026: Key Highlights

✅ Official Notification: Expected in July 2026.

✅ Application Mode: Strictly Online via ssc.gov.in.

✅ Vacancies: Approximately 3,000+ to 3,700+ posts anticipated.

✅ Eligibility: 12th Pass from a recognized board, age 18-27 years.

✅ Selection Process: Computer-Based Examination (Tier I & Tier II).

Important Dates for SSC CHSL 2026 (Expected)

Keep track of these tentative dates to ensure you don't miss any crucial deadlines for the SSC CHSL 2026 application and examination cycle.

Event Expected Date
SSC CHSL 2026 Notification Release July 2026
Online Application Start Date July 2026 (along with notification)
Online Application Last Date August 2026 (approx. one month after start)
Last Date for Fee Payment To be announced (shortly after application close)
Application Correction Window To be announced
Tier-I Exam Dates (CBE) July - September 2026
Tier-II Exam Dates To be announced (after Tier-I results)
Eligibility Criteria: Are You Qualified?

Before you proceed with the application, it's vital to confirm that you meet the SSC CHSL 2026 eligibility requirements. The criteria primarily revolve around nationality, educational qualification, and age limit.

1. Nationality
Candidates must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal, or a subject of Bhutan. Individuals of Indian origin who have migrated from certain countries with the intention of permanently settling in India are also eligible.
2. Educational Qualification
  • For most posts (LDC, JSA, PA, SA), candidates must have passed the 12th Standard or equivalent examination from a recognized Board or University.
  • For Data Entry Operator (DEO) in the Office of Comptroller and Auditor General of India (C&AG), candidates must have passed the 12th Standard in Science stream with Mathematics as a subject from a recognized Board or equivalent.
  • Candidates appearing for their 12th-grade examinations are also eligible to apply, provided they obtain the essential qualification by the crucial cut-off date mentioned in the official notification.
3. Age Limit (as of the crucial cut-off date)

The minimum age to apply for SSC CHSL posts is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 27 years.

Age relaxation is provided for candidates belonging to reserved categories as per government norms:

Category Age Relaxation
SC/ST 5 years
OBC 3 years
PwBD (Unreserved) 10 years
PwBD (OBC) 13 years
PwBD (SC/ST) 15 years
Ex-Servicemen 3 years after deduction of the military service rendered from the actual age as on the closing date
Defence Personnel disabled in operation during hostilities with any foreign country or in a disturbed area and released consequent thereto (UR/OBC/SC/ST) 3 years (UR/OBC), 8 years (SC/ST)
Central Govt. Civilian Employees (UR/OBC/SC/ST) Up to 40 years of age (UR), Up to 43 years of age (OBC), Up to 45 years of age (SC/ST)
Documents Required for Online Application

To ensure a smooth application process, have the following documents ready in the prescribed format:

✅ Scanned passport-sized photograph (taken within the last three months, with the date of capture printed on it). Format: JPG, Size: 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm.

✅ Scanned signature. Format: JPG, Size: 10-20 KB, Dimensions: 140 x 60 pixels.

✅ Valid Photo ID proof (Aadhaar Card is mandatory for registration, or alternatives like PAN Card, Voter ID, Passport, Driving License).

✅ 10th and 12th Mark sheets/Certificates (for date of birth and educational eligibility proof).

✅ Category Certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) if applicable.

✅ Disability Certificate for PwBD candidates (if applicable).

✅ Valid Email ID and Mobile Number (for registration and communication).

Step-by-Step Guide to Apply Online for SSC CHSL 2026

The application process for SSC CHSL 2026 involves two main stages: One-Time Registration (OTR) and filling out the application form. Follow these detailed steps to complete your application successfully.

Step 1: Complete One-Time Registration (OTR)

If you are a new user, you must first register on the official SSC website.

  1. Visit the official SSC website: www.ssc.gov.in.
  2. Click on 'Register Now' or 'New User' under the Login section.
  3. Enter your basic details: Aadhaar Number (or other valid ID proof), Name, Father's Name, Mother's Name, Date of Birth, Mobile Number, and Email ID.
  4. Provide your 10th Class Roll Number and Board.
  5. Set a password and answer security questions.
  6. Review all details carefully and click 'Final Submit'.
  7. Verify your mobile number and email ID using OTPs sent to them.
  8. Upon successful registration, you will receive a unique Registration Number and Password. Save these credentials for future logins.
Step 2: Fill the SSC CHSL 2026 Application Form

Once your OTR is complete, or if you are an already registered user, proceed with the application for SSC CHSL 2026.

  1. Log in to the SSC Candidate Portal using your Registration Number and Password.
  2. On your dashboard, locate the 'SSC CHSL 2026 Notification' and click on the 'Apply' link.
  3. Your basic details from OTR will be pre-filled. Fill in any remaining personal, educational, and communication details.
  4. Upload your scanned photograph and signature in the specified format and size. (Ensure the photograph meets the exact specifications, including the date of capture).
  5. Select your three preferred examination centers from the available options.
  6. Choose your post preferences based on your eligibility (LDC/JSA, DEO, DEO Grade 'A', Postal Assistant, Sorting Assistant).
  7. Review your entire application form meticulously before proceeding. Make sure all information is accurate to avoid any discrepancies later.
  8. Proceed to pay the application fee, if applicable to your category.
  9. After successful payment, click on 'Submit'.
  10. Download and print a copy of the submitted application form and the payment receipt for your records.
Application Fee

The application fee for the SSC CHSL 2026 examination is ₹100/- (Rupees One Hundred only).

However, several categories are exempted from paying the fee:

  • Women candidates
  • Candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC)
  • Candidates belonging to Scheduled Tribes (ST)
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)
  • Ex-servicemen (ESM) eligible for reservation

The fee can be paid conveniently through online modes such as BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or by using Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, RuPay Credit, or Debit cards.

Don't wait until the last moment to apply! Technical glitches or heavy server loads can occur closer to the deadline. Submit your SSC CHSL 2026 application well in advance to avoid any last-minute stress.

The SSC CHSL examination offers a fantastic opportunity for young individuals to kickstart their careers in central government services. By staying informed and meticulously following the application guidelines, you can significantly enhance your chances of success. Good luck!
